name: zmodel_const_find_or_append_normal_index
description: zModel_Const::FindOrAppendNormalIndex merges normals within the recovered strict normal tolerance and appends unmatched normals to the zDi normal array.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the normal tolerance merge and append paths. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482a10 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx, normal in edx, and return of the existing or appended normal index, or -1 after the warning path.
Binary Ninja assembly validates strict absolute-delta comparisons against the double tolerance at 0x4d2ac0, realloc growth of self->normals, and incrementing self->normalCount after append.

Binary Ninja data at 0x4d2ac0 validates the recovered normal merge tolerance as 0.0001, string data at 0x4e165c validates the normal-count warning message, and data at 0x4d2ab8 validates the recovered warning threshold as the double value 921.6.
The native smoke verifies first append, within-tolerance merge without count growth, and outside-tolerance append through the production normal array.
